title: Copilot Chat gets per-prompt content source filters, on by default for licensed users
summary: MC1548004 (11 November 2026) adds a source selection control to Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: users can scope a single prompt to one or more content sources, and Copilot grounds the answer only in those. Available sources are the ones enabled in the tenant, including Graph connectors and federated connectors. The selection does not persist across prompts. Rollout to worldwide tenants starts mid-November 2026, enabled by default for users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.
why: Microsoft states the filter changes where Copilot retrieves from, not what a user may access — permissions, compliance boundaries and data handling are unchanged. The governance side effect is visibility: every connector you have enabled becomes a named, selectable source in the prompt box, which is a good moment to check that each Graph or federated connector is one you actually approved and scoped.
todo: List enabled Graph connectors and federated connectors and confirm each has an owner, a documented data scope and is in your approved AI inventory.
Update user guidance: scoped prompts reduce noise, but do not bypass sensitivity labels or DLP for Copilot.
No admin toggle is described in the message; plan communication rather than configuration.
